backlogged.summary: The F99 tests build the prompt by calling run.builderPrompt with the arguments the fake builder receives. They never go through defaultBuild, which is where `config` and `redact` are passed to builderPrompt. If that call in lib/run.mjs stopped passing `config` or `redact`, the F99 tests would still pass. An end-to-end test with a fake adapter that captures the real prompt would close this gap.
verificationSection is only added when `config` is passed to builderPrompt. A caller that omits it silently gets no `## Verification` section.
